The food was fine, but not something I would specially revisit for.
It was decent, but didn’t really stand out to me.
The solkadi was above average (3/5), while the bombil fry, kolambi fry, surmai thali, and modak were average overall (2.5/5).
The taste was simple, which some people may enjoy, but I personally felt the place is slightly overhyped for the price point.
The quantity also felt less compared to the pricing.
A few accompaniments usually served with fish fry, like green chutney, were unavailable too. Overall, not a bad experience, but slightly overrated in my opinion.
Personally, I still prefer home-cooked seafood over this.
